tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind cards, on every desk screen.

tokens.name: color-surface-base
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, inputs, the top bar.

tokens.name: color-selected
tokens.usage: Sunken fills: tab track, room-type bands, today column, skeletons.

tokens.name: color-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on table rows and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: color-table-head
tokens.usage: Table header band.

tokens.name: color-sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar ground.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Body text on color-bg, color-surface-base, color-selected, color-sidebar.

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text on the same four grounds as color-ink.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: color-field
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders. Holds 3:1 on color-surface-base and color-bg.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Peacock teal. Primary buttons, selected nav item, links. The one brand hue. Never a stay or room state.

tokens.name: color-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on primary buttons. A solid colour, never an opacity fade.

tokens.name: color-primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active stepper step, the copilot source chip.

tokens.name: color-primary-tint-fg
tokens.usage: Text on color-primary-tint.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus outline, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: color-action-primary-surface
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Same value as color-primary; kept because ui-kit reads this name.

tokens.name: color-action-primary-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-primary and color-action-primary-surface.

tokens.name: color-action-destructive-surface
tokens.usage: Cancel, void, refund and destructive confirm buttons.

tokens.name: color-action-destructive-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on destructive buttons.

tokens.name: color-action-destructive-fg
tokens.usage: Text on destructive fills.

tokens.name: color-status-settled-fg
tokens.usage: Good and finished: Paid, Clear, Complete, Resolved, Active. Never a booking state.

tokens.name: color-status-settled-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind color-status-settled-fg.

tokens.name: color-status-informational-fg
tokens.usage: Neutral facts and notices: Info, In progress.

tokens.name: color-status-informational-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind color-status-informational-fg.

tokens.name: color-status-attention-fg
tokens.usage: Needs a look soon: Warn, Pending, Due out today, Low.

tokens.name: color-status-attention-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind color-status-attention-fg.

tokens.name: color-status-exception-fg
tokens.usage: Wrong or blocking: Fail, Overstay count, No-show, Failed.

tokens.name: color-status-exception-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind color-status-exception-fg.

tokens.name: color-status-vip-fg
tokens.usage: The VIP mark only.

tokens.name: color-status-vip-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind the VIP mark.

tokens.name: color-status-cancelled-fg
tokens.usage: Cancelled, Checked out, Archived, Off.

tokens.name: color-status-cancelled-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind color-status-cancelled-fg.
